content:
Create But Brassless 是一款材質包，將列車車身的材質由黃銅改為更接近鐵的樣式。為了保持風格一致，它也會替換其他包含列車車身相關方塊的模組材質！

![Blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/ANWVOW6J/images/63b380c06b5e295828bdbb87bd1c502a63699383.png)

目前支援的模組：
<details>
<summary>展開</summary>

[Create（這就不用說了）](https://modrinth.com/mod/create)

[Create: Blocks & Bogies](https://modrinth.com/mod/blocks-bogies)

[Create Encased](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-encased)

[Create Train Parts](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-train-parts)

[Create: Mixed Casing](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-mixed-casing)

[Create : New Furnitures（在 Modrinth 上找不到）](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/create-new-furnitures)

[Dramatic Doors（內含 Create 的門，別問）](https://modrinth.com/mod/dramatic-doors)

[Create: Prismatic Shine](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-prismatic-shine)

[Create Trash Cans（材質包）](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/create-trash-cans)

</details>

如果我在其他模組中發現更多需要「去黃銅化」的列車車身，我會嘗試將其納入支援。
